summary: A Bootstrap one-pager for a condensed sans: a stack of full-width flat-colour bands, each either one OpenType feature demonstrated by a looping GIF (small caps, figures, case forms, localized forms, stylistic sets, ligatures) or one giant slab-fitted German word with a hard drop shadow, then the character set, an 80-style list, a variable-font teaser and download links.

instances.look: On flat sky blue, a three-line slab-fitted pitch 'A new Typeface. / Not just condensed, / it's Compressa!' (last line lime green) on the left and a huge white capital on the right that cycles through the letters of the name with a pale-blue ghost of the next letter behind it
instances.ux: Fixed blue nav bar above; the glyph on the right is an animated GIF spelling C-O-M-P-R-E-S-S-A letter by letter
instances.learn: A slab-fitted pitch (each line scaled to the same width) next to a single cycling capital: the sentence sells, the glyph loop shows the letterforms one at a time

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed ~1020px tall (113vh); Bootstrap container 1170px centred; left col-5 holds the 3-line headline vertically centred (~x=150, y≈340–650); right col-7 centres a ~300×460px GIF of one capital
reconstruction.typography: Headline slabText-fitted lines: 'A new Typeface.' 112px, 'Not just condensed,' 94px, 'it's Compressa!' 120px; Compressa PRO Regular condensed, white then lime #8fd14f; tight leading ~1.0
reconstruction.behaviour: Looping GIF (compressa-name.gif) shows each letter of the name in turn, the next letter fading in as a translucent pale-blue layer behind; headline static; nav fixed
reconstruction.assets: Animated GIF of the name's capitals (could be rebuilt as CSS keyframes cycling letters)
reconstruction.html: #headerwrap.colorwrap-00 > .col-lg-5 h2.slabtextdone > span.slabtext ×3 (inline font-size per line) + .col-lg-7 img[src=compressa-name.gif]

instances.look: A run of one-screen bands, each in its own flat colour (lime, pale yellow, mint, salmon, olive, mustard), with a feature name on one side ('Small Caps', 'Case-Sensitive Forms', '6 Stylistic Sets', 'Ligatures', 'Localized Forms') and a large looping GIF on the other: 'Aa Bb Cc Dd' turning into small caps, '139' cycling through the figure sets (with a list of the 9 numeral styles), 'Hg' case forms, 'Ugly Babies' swapping stylistic sets, 'ffl' ligature, Polish weekday names in a 3-slide carousel
instances.ux: Nothing to click except the carousel dots on Localized Forms; every feature demonstrates itself on a loop
instances.learn: One feature per full-colour band with a self-playing before/after loop: the visitor learns the OpenType feature set just by scrolling, no toggles needed

reconstruction.layout: Each band ~820px tall (91vh), full-bleed colour; Bootstrap two-column split (col-6/col-6 or col-8/col-4): heading at x≈150 vertically ~y=200, GIF ~520–650px wide on the other side; the figures band adds two col-3 lists of feature names; Localized Forms is centred: heading, a 3-slide carousel (col-6 offset-3) and a centred paragraph of ~110 language names
reconstruction.typography: Feature headings h1 ~96px Compressa PRO Regular, dark grey #2f2f2f; samples in the GIFs ~150–420px; figure-style list 26px; language list ~22px
reconstruction.behaviour: GIF loops: default forms → feature forms (small caps with a fading lighter row, figures cycling proportional/tabular/oldstyle, superior/inferior, case-sensitive punctuation, ss01–ss06 alternates fading in, f+f+l → ligature); Bootstrap carousel auto-advances every ~5s
reconstruction.content: Feature names as headings; samples chosen per feature ('Aa Bb Cc Dd', '139', 'Hg', 'Ugly Babies', 'ffl', 'piątek środa poniedziałek')
reconstruction.assets: One animated GIF per feature (compressa-caps.gif, compressa-ziffern.gif, compressa-casesensitive.gif, compressa-StylisticSet.gif, compressa-ligatures.gif) and 3 PNGs for localized forms

instances.look: Between the feature bands, single giant words fitted to the container width, each with a hard offset drop shadow: 'geile Type!' dark grey with white shadow on red, 'isso!' white with purple shadow on violet, 'Space is limited' sky-blue on orange, 'Hopfensmoothie' yellow on teal
instances.ux: static; each has a title tooltip translating the slang ('German for: Horny Typeface!', 'that's so!', Tschichold quote)
instances.learn: Interleave one-word punchlines between explanatory sections: the rhythm alternates learning and shouting, and each word is a display specimen

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed bands 510–820px tall; one centred line, slab-fitted to the 1170px container, vertically centred
reconstruction.typography: Compressa PRO Regular at 428px ('geile Type!'), 628px ('isso!'), 296px ('Space is limited'), 286px ('Hopfensmoothie'); hard text-shadow offset ~6–10px in a contrasting tone
reconstruction.behaviour: none (slabText.js fits the size on load and resize)
reconstruction.content: German slang and puns: 'geile Type!', 'isso!', 'Hopfensmoothie' (beer), 'Space is limited' (a nod to condensed type)

instances.look: Under the Localized Forms carousel, a centred justified paragraph 'Languages: Afrikaans, Albanian, Asu, Basque, … Welsh, Zulu' in small dark condensed type on salmon
instances.learn: Put the language list right under the localized-forms demo so coverage and locl are read together

reconstruction.layout: Centred paragraph ~900px wide, ~7 lines, below the carousel, ~60px bottom padding
reconstruction.typography: ~22px Compressa PRO Regular, centred, dark brown #3a2a28, leading ~1.4

instances.look: 'Characters' in lime green, then the set as centred running lines in roman and again in italic: caps, lowercase, small caps, two figure sets, accents and symbols, with the stylistic alternates (I, U, a, g, i, j, l, ß) highlighted in lime inline
instances.learn: Insert each alternate right after its default letter and colour it: the alphabet line doubles as an alternates index

reconstruction.layout: Light grey #efefef band ~1714px; centred block of 5 lines per style, roman then italic, ~1000px wide
reconstruction.typography: Heading 96px lime; glyph lines h1 ~70px Compressa PRO Regular, word-spacing −0.1em, then compressa-it italic; small caps line via smcp class; alternates and the cap ẞ in lime #98db35
reconstruction.content: A–Z with alternates, a–z with alternates, small caps, lining and oldstyle figures, accented letters, currency and punctuation
reconstruction.html: #characters h1 lines with span.stylisticset.color-01 (alternates) and span.feature_on (smcp / onum)

instances.look: 'Styles' at the left and 'NOW AVAILABLE – AS SINGLE CUTS: 80 FONTS!' (the 80 blinking) over three columns per width (Extra Condensed, Neutral, Expanded; then Condensed, Extra Expanded), each a list of 16 style names in small blue link text
instances.ux: Each style name links to that single font's shop page on preusstype.com
instances.learn: Group the style list by width with small-cap headers so 80 fonts read as 5 tidy columns

reconstruction.layout: Light cyan band; col-3 'Styles' heading at left, col-9 with a headline and a 3-column grid (each col ~290px) of style lists, two rows of groups; ~1120px tall
reconstruction.typography: 'Styles' 96px; headline ~36px small caps (feature_on → smcp); group headers ~26px small caps dark; style names ~19px Compressa PRO in link blue #3296da, presumably set in their own width
reconstruction.behaviour: '80' blinks via a CSS opacity keyframe (blink_me-02)
reconstruction.content: All 80 style names: 5 widths × 8 weights × roman/italic

instances.look: On violet, 'Now available as Variable Font' in white over a framed screenshot of the Axis-Praxis specimen page ('COMPRESSA' condensed above 'EXPANDA' extended on a blue panel), with two small link lines below
instances.ux: Links out to the Axis-Praxis online tester and to the PreussType shop ('Test, enjoy and order at PreussType.com', the link text blinking)
instances.learn: When there is no on-page tester, a screenshot of an external playground plus a link still shows the axis range at a glance

reconstruction.behaviour: Shop link text blinks (CSS opacity keyframes)
reconstruction.content: Variable-font announcement, credits to Laurence Penney

instances.look: 'Compressa is the perfect typeface for:' in lime, then a justified tower of use cases, each line slab-fitted to the same width so sizes swing from ~70px ('editorial design, magazines, newspapers, brochures') to 515px ('t-shirts'), ending 'You have so many, many, many creative possibilities!' in italic
instances.ux: Every other line pulses lighter/darker (blinking) as you scroll past
instances.learn: Fit every line of a list to one column width: line length drives the size, so short words become huge and the list becomes a typographic poster

reconstruction.layout: Light cyan band ~3000px; single centred column ~940px wide (x≈250–1190); ~16 lines, flush both sides by size fitting, ~10px gaps
reconstruction.typography: Intro line ~60px lime; list lines slabText-fitted 70–515px Compressa PRO Regular, dark #2f2f2f, alternate lines in a muted slate blue mid-blink; last line italic ~50px
reconstruction.behaviour: Alternate lines (span.blink_me-01) fade in and out with a CSS opacity keyframe loop
reconstruction.content: Use cases: logos, displays and signage; editorial design; advertising; web design & apps; branding & packaging; letterheads; greeting cards; prominent headlines & titles; posters & prints; t-shirts; typographic illustrations; web banners; large type size & lot of text in small spaces
